title: Buddy Bolden's repertoire and 'The House Got Ready'
summary: Bolden played old blues; Amacker recalls tunes like Funky Butt and The House Got Ready, which got dancers wild.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: What kind of stuff did Buddy Bowden play?
Oh this old old iron blues stuff like that. You remember any of them? Well you see the old old iron blues he played. On the piano I did but not on this guitar. On the piano I know some.
No you know the names of any of them.

I know some of them on the piano. I know some of them on the piano. I know some of them on the piano. I know some of them on the piano. But yet they sound good to the people and they just ring their heads off dancing. They just dance their feet off dancing them. Blues on the piano. Old time blues. And they go to the place like that. They stop everything else listening to me play things like that. Old time blues on the piano. And we play Funky Bud, Funky Bud, Take It Away?

Yeah. Things like that. Buddy Bowling that was during that day. Used to be a radio called The House Got Ready. Never took a break. The House Got Ready. And he played that Buddy Bowling? Yeah. I don't know that.
The House Got Ready. That was a bitch play.

The House Got Ready. How fast was it? Yeah. That's a rough number. The House Got Ready. Was it a pretty good thing? Yeah. It was a fast number or slow or what? It was a fast number. It was a dirty. Could you hum just a little bit of it?

And then the whole music, they'd run all over the place and dance all over the place. And they would have played, oh The House Got Ready. Oh The House Got Ready. Oh The House Got Ready. I could think of a number though. The piano. The House Got Ready. They danced all over the place. See, The House Got Ready. It was tough. It was tough. Those were crazy names, but they were crazy about dancing the day. It's so, so. It was crazy, but the, but there's, it's as crazy as this stuff is today, you know. People, there's wild about dancing this. Wild about coming to the dance that had that going on, you know. Yet it wasn't no good, but yet they were crazy about going to the packing house with that stuff.
